lead: Vyjayanthimala is an Indian film actor, born on 13 August 1936 in Chennai.
As of 2026, she is 90 years old, and her birth date places her under the Leo sign.
She has 59 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha and member of Rajya Sabha.

This profile collects the Vyjayanthimala facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Vyjayanthimala — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Vyjayanthimala was born on 13 August 1936 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her mother, Vasundhara Devi.
She received her education at Good Shepherd Convent, Chennai.
She is recorded as speaking Bangla and Tamil.

sections.heading: Vyjayanthimala — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, politician and choreographer as her occupations.

She has held the following offices: Member of the Lok Sabha (1985–1993), member of Rajya Sabha (1993–1999), Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991), Member of the 7th Lok Sabha and Member of the 8th Lok Sabha. She is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
